item.title: 1,500 Special Olympics Arizona athletes expected for basketball, cheer competitions in Mesa
item.description: Special Olympics Arizona (SOAZ) is expecting more than 3,000 athletes, partners and coaches for one of its biggest competitions of the year, which will take place in Mesa.

item.title: 2 arrested for conspiring to distribute 50,000 fentanyl pills after shooting at DEA agents
item.description: Two men, one being from Phoenix, were arrested Tuesday for conspiring to distribute what authorities suspect to be around 50,000 fentanyl pills.

item.title: US military used laser to disable Customs and Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser to shoot down a Customs and Border Protection drone in airspace near El Paso, Texas, members of Congress said Thursday.
